notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 400 x 300; the first setOption at T0.
events in order at T0 + t; a sample is zr.animation.update(), a refresh of the display list, and a read of what the case's probes name.

cases.note: 300 candles on 400 px: candleWidth <= 1.3, every box simple -- each still enters, its points out of the open price's (enter timing, its row)
the same with animationDelay idx * 100: each simple box waits its turn
a merge adds two candles: the kept ones updateProps their points (update timing, their row), the new ones enter out of transInit (enter timing, their row)
the same with animationDelay idx * 100 and animationDelayUpdate idx * 100
simple boxes in a merge that changes the values: each updateProps its points

b (10) lies wholly under min 20: BarView keeps it, ignore, its shape clipped to the plot's bottom edge (height 0); a merge to 60 brings it back from there (updateProps, update timing, its row), not out of an enter
c (70) goes to 5, under min: kept and ignored at once, tweening to the edge; then back to 90
a merge adds d (5), wholly clipped: created, ignored, kept; a second merge to 80 grows it from the edge at update timing

the category axis starts at b (min 1): a lies left of the plot, kept, ignored, clipped to the left edge with no width; a merge to min 0 slides it in from that edge (x and width tween, update timing), not grown in place
markLines named a and b; a merge writes them as b then a: LineDraw's diff pairs them by id (the name), so the line at index 0 (now b) tweens from where b was
unnamed markLines: the id is 'e' + two NULs + the index -- paired by index
a merge drops the line named a and adds c: b moves from b, c enters (percent 0 -> 1), a is gone at once

s1 (with a markLine and a markPoint) toggled off by the legend and on again: its markers' draws are kept by the marker views -- on again they update from where they were (the axis changed back), they do not enter again

a notMerge setOption of the same series with s1 unselected in the legend: s1's view is kept (the same model id) and not rendered -- remove(): BarView._clear fades every bar out (removeElementWithFadeOut: 200 ms cubicOut) on the view's last model

two merges at the same instant: the first drops c, the second brings it back -- each setOption renders: c's old bar fades out (a ghost) and a new one enters from no height (the second render's add: initProps, enter timing)
two merges at the same instant that move every bar: the second updateProps from where the first's tween stands (its start) -- the same as one
a merge changes the values (the order changes): each piece updateProps its opacity and its four points, its outer label's style x / y (update timing, its row)
the same with the labels inside
animationDelayUpdate idx * 100: each piece and its label wait their row's turn
a merge adds a row: the new piece fades in (its points set), the kept ones move to make room

guards.name: br-back: b kept and ignored before
br-back: b comes back on the update timing
ml-name-swap: index 0 starts from where b was
mk-legend: on again, the line does not enter
fn-update: a piece tweens its points
